This chapter delves into the integration of AI ethics in computing education across India's top engineering institutions. The analysis reveals that only 2.21% of the 3395 courses analyzed included any substantive AI ethics content, with most addressing it superficially. The pervasive integration of artificial intelligence (AI) across domains such as healthcare, governance, finance, and education has intensified scrutiny of its ethical implications, including algorithmic bias, privacy risks, accountability, and societal impact.
